Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the attachments. Looping in Vanessa (collections) and Aditya (payments ops) to run ledger matching. A few quick clarifying asks so we can propose the cleanest path for your reclaim: 

1) Do you want Redwood to issue a credit note that documents the EUR 18,000 as a VAT line (preferred for audit trail), or would you prefer we reissue a net invoice? We can do either but need your preference.
2) Confirm the payer entity that sent the funds (legal name and VAT number) — you provided AQU1234567, is the remittance under the same legal entity as the invoice?
3) The bank trace you shared (FR-BNK-20250614-8872) — can you confirm whether the payment hit the virtual account 4451 or was sent as an intercompany sweep?

Vanessa / Aditya — can you confirm whether the EUR 18,000 currently sits as an unapplied credit in the ledger and whether we can map it to invoice 78932 without a manual journal? If mapping requires a credit note, please propose wording and an allocation CSV we can send back to AquaSys.

I’ll aim to get back to Elena within 24 hours with a recommended allocation and next steps.

Best,
Priya Natarajan

On Mon, Jun 15, 2025 at 09:12 AM billing@aquasys.com wrote:
> We processed a bulk payment on 14-Jun-2025 that should satisfy Invoice 78932 (EUR 123,450) ...

Quick reconciliation update from Treasury: the incoming file shows two settlements posted on 2025-06-14 — ledger refs RED-PAY-3321 (EUR 105,450) applied to invoice 78932, and a separate incoming credit of EUR 18,000 that the bank tagged as "withholding/tax". That EUR 18,000 currently sits in our suspense/unapplied bucket (suspense account 2401) pending direction.

Proposed approach (see attached allocation_proposal.csv):
- Apply RED-PAY-3321 to invoice 78932 for the principal amount.
- Move EUR 18,000 from suspense into a new tax-withheld clearing sub-ledger with metadata: tax_tag=eu_withheld, source_bank=FR-4451, payer_vat=AQU1234567.
- Issue a credit note that documents the EUR 18,000 as "tax withheld at source" (this preserves the original gross invoice for audit, while giving AquaSys a formal document for reclaim).

Notes / questions:
- If AquaSys prefers a net reissue (invoice minus the EUR 18,000), finance will need a signed remittance confirmation for their records before we create a negative invoice.
- Aditya, can treasury generate the formal bank evidence pack (bank SWIFT trace + MT940 extract) and attach to the credit note record? If yes, we should attach bank_advice_20250614.pdf and the trace to the credit note in the customer portal.

If Elena confirms credit note, I will: create the allocation CSV, open a credit note record (CN-2025-0091), and update the ledger tags so AR and tax can report the withheld amount separately.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
